Binary specialisation matrices behind the complexity measures, and the product
space each city implies.

## Setup

```{python}
import sys

sys.path.append("..")
sys.path.append(".")

import os

from complexity import (
    load_employment,
    compute_binary_rca,
    compute_pci,
    compute_proximity,
    mst_with_threshold,
    nodf,
    PRODUCT_SPACE_THRESHOLDS,
)
from si_plots import plot_rca_matrices, plot_product_space_grid
```

## Configuration

```{python}
FIGS_DIR = "../../figs/SI"
os.makedirs(FIGS_DIR, exist_ok=True)

CITY_ORDER = ["Bay Area", "Los Angeles", "Mexico City", "Rio de Janeiro"]

EMPLOYMENT_PATHS = {
    "Bay Area": "../../data/employment_bay.csv",
    "Los Angeles": "../../data/employment_la.csv",
    "Mexico City": "../../data/employment_cdmx.csv",
    "Rio de Janeiro": "../../data/employment_rio.csv",
}
```

## Complexity Quantities

```{python}
employment_data, rca_matrices, pci_data, proximity_data, graphs = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}

for city, path in EMPLOYMENT_PATHS.items():
    employment = load_employment(path)
    matrix = compute_binary_rca(employment)

    employment_data[city] = employment
    rca_matrices[city] = matrix
    pci_data[city] = compute_pci(matrix)
    proximity_data[city] = compute_proximity(matrix)
    graphs[city] = mst_with_threshold(proximity_data[city],
                                      PRODUCT_SPACE_THRESHOLDS[city])

    print(f"{city:16s} {matrix.shape[0]:4d} zones x {matrix.shape[1]:2d} sectors  "
          f"NODF = {nodf(matrix):.1f}  {graphs[city].number_of_edges():3d} edges")
```

## Specialisation Matrices

```{python}
fig = plot_rca_matrices(rca_matrices, CITY_ORDER)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/r3c7_rca_matrices.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```

## Product Space

```{python}
fig = plot_product_space_grid(CITY_ORDER, proximity_data, pci_data,
                              employment_data, graphs)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/product_space_grid.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```

## Complexity against Its Components

```{python}
import geopandas as gpd

from complexity import zone_components
from si_plots import plot_eci_components

ZONE_PATHS = {
    "Bay Area": "../../data/h3_bay_8.geojson",
    "Los Angeles": "../../data/h3_la_8.geojson",
    "Mexico City": "../../data/h3_cdmx_8.geojson",
    "Rio de Janeiro": "../../data/map_informality_eci.geojson",
}

zone_frames = {city: gpd.read_file(path) for city, path in ZONE_PATHS.items()}
components = {city: zone_components(rca_matrices[city]) for city in CITY_ORDER}

fig = plot_eci_components(zone_frames, components, CITY_ORDER)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/r3c12_eci_div_ubi_scatter.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```
